All four options were rewritten into genuinely competing functions (A light relief without bearing, B the reviewer's objection to the book's priorities [key], C a cause of the wind-up, D a demand for a different book). Independent check: no option is recoverable from the prompt; only 'Det är det inte' and 'jag hade gärna läst tjugo sidor till om just det' in stycke 8 select B. The fresh G-STEM regate reaches the same conclusion explicitly: 'DECISIVE CHECK: the earlier stem-entailment kill is REPAIRED'.

Old q2 D ended '...och svarade ensam för räkenskaperna', making B, C and D all describe the ABSENCE of a safeguard and leaving key A standing alone as the only ordinary regulation — visible from form. New D ('Föreståndaren utsågs av prästen bland socknens största jordägare, medan kyrkvärden valdes av sockenstämman.') is a positive appointment rule with the roles swapped, contradicted by 'den föreståndare som sockenstämman valt'. Shipping frames are now 2 positive rules (A, D) / 2 absent-safeguards (B, C); form no longer isolates the key. The fresh G-STEM regate independently reports A and D 'stay genuinely undecided without the text'.

findings.claim: las-b14-002 is the only unit in batch14 that never received an independent expert-language-review pass. Its `language` record was written by the pedagogy agent that had just authored the new Swedish, and both idiom defects the G-SPRÅK panel flagged survive verbatim in the shipping file — one of them inside a shipped answer option.
findings.evidence: reviews/language.jsonl carries five 'reviewed_by':'language-review/opus' / verdict 'CORRECTED' records (elf-b14-001/002/003, las-b14-001, las-b14-003) and, for las-b14-002, a single line 'reviewed_by':'pedagogy-review/opus', verdict 'CLEAR', note 'native-Swedish check during stem repair' — self-report by the stage that made the edits. G-SPRÅK panel on this unit: ALL THREE voters flagged 'de partier som inte tjänar något argument alls' as a calque of English 'serve an argument' (vote 1 major, votes 2 and 3 minor; Swedish 'tjäna' collocates with syfte/ändamål); TWO of three flagged 'gjorde ägandet till magasinen oklart' as wrong government (vote 1 major, vote 2 major; Swedish has 'äganderätten till X' or 'ägandet av X'), and vote 2 correctly notes this one sits in q3 OPTION A, not the passage. Both strings are present unchanged in candidates-final/las-b14-002.json. Nothing downstream can catch this: promote.py's REVIEW_STAGES accepts 'CLEAR' as a clearing language verdict, and vfinal_fold.py reads only gkey-resolved, gdistractor and this audit — it never reads G-SPRÅK. The new q4 stem, all four new q4 options and the new q2 D were written at the pedagogy repair and have had no language gate of any kind (G-SPRÅK is passage-scoped).
findings.why: Scored minor, not major, on three grounds: every G-SPRÅK vote returned verdict 'flag' with zero lethal findings, so the gate fleet itself dispositioned this as survivable; neither defect changes which option is correct or what the item teaches; and this batch's own audit precedent (las-b14-003, 'two native-idiom defects flagged by the G-SPRÅK dissenting vote survive verbatim') scores the identical class of defect as minor. It is nonetheless the finding to act on before promotion, because it is exactly the failure mode final_verify was built to prevent — 'an edit applied by a review stage never ships on that stage's own self-report' — and this is the one route final_verify cannot see. Remediation: run expert-language-review on the unit; at minimum change q3 A to 'gjorde äganderätten till magasinen oklar' and repair 'tjänar något argument' in stycke 8 (note that the q4 stem and the q4 rationale both lean on that clause, so the three must be edited together, and any passage edit re-opens M-BANDS/M-ECHO/G-SPRÅK).

findings.stage_challenged: pedagogy + final_verify (disposition of the fresh G-STEM majors)
findings.claim: The fresh G-STEM regate recovers the key passage-blind on three of the four questions and files three major flags saying so. No review record dispositions any of them, and the fold that produces final_verify does not read G-STEM at all, so the newest and most adverse evidence on this unit lands in no downstream record.
findings.evidence: verdicts-vfinal/verdicts-gstem.jsonl (17:43:18, the last-written evidence for this unit): q1 WORLD_KNOWLEDGE blind_pick 'C' (key C), q2 PARTIALLY blind_pick null, q3 PARTIALLY blind_pick 'D' (key D), q4 PARTIALLY blind_pick 'B' (key B) — all four verdict 'flag', all four severity 'major'. A passage-blind solver therefore scores 3/4 against a 1/4 baseline. Timing rules out any stage having seen them: language closed 17:33:34, pedagogy 17:34:45, and the regate ran 17:43:18; reviews/integrated.jsonl (17:52:59) records 'MINOR_NOTES' with no findings array. vfinal_fold.py's docstring lists its inputs as verdicts-gkey-resolved.jsonl, verdicts-gdistractor.jsonl and audits/<cid>.json — G-STEM is not among them.
findings.why: Each individual disposition is charter-correct and I would not overturn any of them: gates/README.md line 79 routes world-knowledge answerability with substantive distractors to flag, and the G-STEM prompt's own calibration section warns that killing on 'a knowledgeable solver can guess the key' is the over-fire that froze the stack in the 2026-07-20 eval. q1's distractors are substantive institutional variants (repayment in money existed elsewhere; an annually-set surcharge is a real alternative), and q3/q4 were only leaned toward, not decided. Kept at minor for that reason. The residue is real all the same — construct validity is a unit-level property and 3/4 blind recovery is the number a human adjudicator should see — so it belongs on the record rather than in a file nothing reads.

findings.claim: The repair's stated justification for the new q4 stem is empirically contradicted by the very regate it was written to satisfy. The repair itself is sound; the shipped metadata overstates its effect.
findings.evidence: generator_meta.self_blind_solve asserts: 'Blind, A is the natural pick from "roligast att läsa", so the stem now points away from the key rather than at it.' The fresh blind G-STEM run on the shipping q4 returned blind_pick 'B' — the key — and explains why the predicted A does not hold: 'A is disfavoured by the stem's own presupposition that the passages fill a function ("har ingen bäring")'. The stem no longer entails an option (I verified this independently and the gate calls the entailment kill REPAIRED), but the specific claim that it now points AWAY from the key is false on the evidence.
findings.why: Informational: the item is unaffected and the repair achieved its actual goal. Recorded because self_blind_solve is a shipped, student-invisible but reviewer-load-bearing field, and a claim in it that the next gate falsifies should not sit on the record unchallenged.

findings.evidence: verdicts/verdicts-gregister.jsonl, verdict flag, severity major: 'q2 option A reproduces the passage clause "Den som inte hade betalat tillbaka till Mikaeli, i slutet av september, fick stå över utlåningen följande vår" almost intact (appositive dropped, till→vid) … HP LÄS keeps options in paraphrase register — cf. var-2015-verb2-LÄS-016 and host-2020-verb2-LÄS-018, whose keys share no contiguous clause with their passages.' Worth a one-line paraphrase edit if the unit is reopened for finding 1 anyway.

findings.claim: q1's family tag contradicts the family definition it is drawn from.
findings.evidence: generator_meta.question_families tags q1 'detalj_ospecificerad', but q1's stem is 'Hur fungerade utlåningen ur ett sockenmagasin enligt texten?' — it cites the text explicitly, which las/families.md (lines 65–66) defines as the distinguishing surface of enligt_texten_detalj ('the families differ only in stem surface — enligt_texten_detalj cites the text explicitly … detalj_ospecificerad anchors on content'). q1 and q2 carry the same 'enligt texten' surface but are tagged as different families.
findings.why: Cosmetic metadata only — no gate consumes question_families and the mix (2 detail + 1 hållning + 1 struktur) is corpus-faithful either way, since the two detail families are 75.5 % combined. Recorded for ledger accuracy.
